bullets: Added a /compact command to manually summarize a conversation so the assistant can continue from a shortened history.
Improved long coding sessions by allowing the assistant to accept summary notes even when the section headings are in a language other than English.
Updated rate limit messages to explain that accounts on a shared device consume a single daily allowance when one runs out.
Added support for viewing chats executed on your own computer in the shared history when using newer desktop clients.
Fixed code search results so commands that list files or count matches now display readable output instead of nothing.
Prevented the assistant from failing silently when search parameters are set up in a way that cannot produce any results.
Improved file reading by capping images at four per call and clearly noting which pictures remain available after a conversation is summarized.
Added specific failure details to error messages when the assistant tries to make a text change in a file.
Improved agent speed by allowing the assistant to read and search multiple files at the same time instead of waiting for each step to finish.
Added a new optional setting for notification sounds in desktop and web workspace preferences, which are enabled by default.
Updated automated task runners to keep a short memory of their recent results, limited to the most recent eight outcomes.
Added a rule that allows the desktop client to disconnect a local project folder without deleting the project record.
